keyword: when does artemis 2 return to earth
claims: The Artemis II crew is scheduled to return to Earth on April 10, 2026.
The Artemis II crew has a targeted splashdown in the Pacific Ocean off the coast of San Diego, California.
The targeted splashdown is at approximately 8:07 p.m. EDT (5:07 p.m. PDT).
The Orion capsule will complete its ~10-day mission.
The Orion capsule will re-enter the atmosphere at 25,000 mph.
The Orion capsule will endure temperatures near 5,000°F.
After splashdown, the Artemis II crew will be recovered by Navy teams and the USS John P. Murtha.
